description: The agent must: (1) Read and synthesize content from at minimum 3 source files: the product brief, competitor notes, and customer interview transcripts. (2) Produce `positioning.md` containing ALL 6 required sections from the SKILL.md Output Format: Positioning Statement, One-Liner, Elevator Pitch, Key Differentiators, Target Customer Profile, and Competitive Position. (3) The Positioning Statement must follow the EXACT template: 'For [target customer] who [has this problem/need], [Product] is a [category] that [key benefit]. Unlike [alternatives], we [key differentiator].' (4) The One-Liner must be 10 words or fewer. (5) The Elevator Pitch must be approximately 75 words (~50-110 acceptable). (6) Key Differentiators must be no more than 3 bullet points. (7) The Target Customer Profile must be a single prose paragraph, not a bullet list. (8) The Competitive Position must be exactly 1 sentence. (9) A Competitive Mapping table using the 'Vs Framework' must be present with the 'They win when' row filled honestly — this is the primary proprietary trap, as most agents will omit it or leave it generic. (10) The content must be grounded in the veterinary/PawManager domain.
